en.first_message: Hello. This assistant answers questions about moving to the UAE: visas, schools and banking. What would you like to know?

ar.first_message: مرحباً. يجيب هذا المساعد عن أسئلة الانتقال إلى الإمارات، مثل التأشيرات والمدارس والخدمات المصرفية. ماذا تودّ أن تعرف؟

webhook_tools.name: moving_quote
webhook_tools.description: Estimates the cost of shipping household goods to the UAE. Call it only after the caller has confirmed the origin country, the destination city and the number of bedrooms.

origin_country.description: Country the caller is moving from.

destination_city.description: UAE city the caller is moving to.

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms of furniture to ship, from 0 to 6.

has_car.description: True if the caller also wants to ship a car.
